lines.text: At the battle of Pharsalus, I kept a line of soldiers in reserve.
lines.say: At the battle of Farsaylus, I kept a line of soldiers in reserve.

lines.text: When Pompey's cavalry charged, my reserve crushed them.
Your emergency fund is your reserve.
Three to six months of expenses, in cash, ready to fight.
Your car breaks. You lose your job. Life charges at you.
No reserve? You sell your investments at the worst time, or grab a credit card, you fucking idiot.
Build your reserve first. Then conquer.
